scope: Lock action availability while the post-login health query is pending; isolated no-NIC debug-fixture VMs
cause: The existing lock guard refused busy requests, but the screen and private action tree still offered Lock. A controlled six-second delay reproduced a dequeued second action with no locker.
limits: The original intermittent run had no busy-state capture. The controlled regression demonstrates the same outcome through the busy guard; it does not reconstruct the exact timing of the earlier run. No physical hardware qualification.
